reason: The runtime exact-approval-binding validator (P3-12-GOV-05) requires an explicit, human-reviewed CIO re-approval naming the exact approval-evidence file this repository is currently trusting for the Upbit identity registry and taxonomy. No such entry exists yet on this branch -- adding the validator call itself to universe/upbit_tradeable_universe.py changes that file, which is itself part of every existing approval candidate exact-hash pin, so the prior v2 exact-hash approval cannot satisfy this check regardless of this list. effective_identity_mapping() and the taxonomy gate both return empty/false until a future, separate CIO decision explicitly adds an entry here.
